curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the test day in order: the vision screening and its lens rules, the knowledge test that leads to the learner license, then the road test with its vehicle and paperwork checks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per test rule; contrast cards separating the two lens rules and the knowledge test from the road test.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that asks which step, document or lens rule applies to an applicant.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the monthly tire checks, then how to sit and reach the pedals and wheel, then medical review for impaired drivers and the non-driver ID card.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each check and seating rule; the tire pressure rule rides on the tread-test card.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on tire checks, seating position and who needs an ID card instead of a license.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the four-year life of a license and the early-renewal window, the grace period and the late-renewal limit, then duplicates and the penalty for a false affidavit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each timing rule plus contrast cards that keep the before, after and late windows apart.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz built on timelines: how many days before or after expiration, and which rule applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who handles class and restriction changes, how name and address changes work, then the license classes from Class D up to Class A.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each change rule and class; contrast cards for address versus name changes and for Class A versus Class B.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that describes a vehicle or a change and asks which class or rule applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Finish with vessel license age rules, carrying and showing your license, and the Hands-Free Law with its fines and points.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for vessel rules, carrying the license and each part of the hands-free law; a contrast card for repeat fines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on vessel ages, showing a license to an officer and hands-free penalties.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec02-m01..sec02-m05; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
